subject.title: feat(chat): UX-012 — token usage progress meter

question: Should this PR add a separate always-visible 2px composer meter, or should the token usage affordance be folded into the current composer context notice?
rationale: Current main already has a composer context usage surface with a freshness contract, and the PR is a maintainer-labeled feature that could create a competing context display without an explicit UI decision.

options.title: Fold Into Current Notice
options.body: Rebase and implement the visual affordance through the existing context notice/view model so freshness, thresholds, and accessibility remain one source of truth.

options.title: Pause For Broader Token Widget Direction
options.body: Leave this PR open until the broader provider quota and footer metadata trackers settle the chat token-visibility product shape.

options.title: Accept A Separate Meter
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally keep a separate base bar, but it needs stale styling, tests, and clear relationship to the current context notice before merge.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Current Notice
recommendation.body: Rebase and implement the visual affordance through the existing context notice/view model so freshness, thresholds, and accessibility remain one source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored this PR and has high-confidence prior history on the persistent chat context usage surface.
